youtube_description:
Jesus... I lost my savings on a betting app. At dinner I laughed like nothing happened. 😔 Bible verse about hiding sin.

Him: Jesus... I lost my savings on a betting app. At dinner I laughed like nothing happened. 😔

Him: One more win would fix it before anyone finds out.

Jesus: That thought is the trap. It's what took the money.

Him: If my father finds out, he'll never trust me again.

Jesus: Hiding it is costing you more than money. Delete the app. Then tell him one true sentence.

"He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy."
